name: am-transfer-pricing
description: Prepare Armenia transfer-pricing workpapers for 2026: identify related persons, controlled cross-border and specified domestic transactions, separate the annual regulation and notification thresholds, select a supported pricing method, calculate a range and reconcile adjustments. Covers local/master documentation, the statutory country-reporting trigger, notification form structure, deadlines and sanctions. Includes two reproducible examples and preserved supplementary research controls for aggr
